accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I have made a decision. This workshop needs rules.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: You have started three experiments while saying that sentence. Explain.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Not boring rules. Helpful rules. Tiny guardrails. Like: before we turn something on, we write down what we think it's going to do.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: You mean a hypothesis. You rejected that idea last time because it sounded "too clipboard-shaped."

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: I was younger then. Also, I'm not saying we need a clipboard. We could use a whiteboard. A handsome whiteboard. With magnets.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: What prompted this sudden conversion to preparation?

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: The 3D printer is running a test piece, and I realized I cannot remember whether I changed the design, the settings, or both. Which is exciting, because whatever comes out will be a surprise.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: That is not what a test is for. If the result is strange, we will have no clean way to tell which change caused it.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Exactly. So rule two: change one thing at a time. See? I'm becoming responsible in real time.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Once this print finishes, we can test whether that claim repeats.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Fair. Rule three: when an experiment does something weird, we don't call it a disaster until we've looked at it.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Rivet
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Acceptable. Though I would like a separate rule prohibiting you from announcing rules five minutes after ignoring them.

accepted_dialogue_lines.speaker: Patch
accepted_dialogue_lines.text: Fine. Put it on the handsome whiteboard. But use the large magnets. The tiny ones vanish into this place like they owe it money.
